additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375522-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S5 313682017001] housing of the charging station has a crack CRM:01811000240
additional_info.body:
Hello
Ankita,
Thank you for waiting,
According to the serial number of the charger it comes from Portuguese factory and we were alerted about this incident from Christian.
We are working together in order to assist you and exchanged information in order to assist you,
It appears the paint cracked after some external force on post dispatch process, our quality control documents and pictures don’t indicate this failure.
To contain the issue it can be tried retouching with a paint with equivalent colour that may be available locally.
The paint should have these characteristics
Sun protection
Other resitance values
Condensation water test (DIN ISO 6270)
1000 h no blistering Infiltration on the scratch track under 1 mm
Salt spray test (DIN ISO 9227)
1000 h no blistering Infiltration on the scratch track under 1 mm
Anything else you may want to ask please do not hesitate,
Thanks in advance,
With best regards,
